event.title: Typhoon Dolphin Strikes Japan, Heads Towards China with Preparations Underway
event.canonical_title: Typhoon Dolphin Strikes Japan, Heads Towards China with Preparations Underway
event.summary: Typhoon Dolphin has hit southern Japan, particularly affecting Okinawa, with maximum sustained winds of 162 km/h and gusts up to 216 km/h. The storm has caused injuries to five elderly individuals, primarily due to falls from strong winds. As the typhoon approaches China, ports have been closed in anticipation of its arrival.

timeline.title: Typhoon Dolphin Hits China's Eastern Coast with High Winds
timeline.summary: Typhoon Dolphin has made landfall on China's eastern coast, bringing sustained winds of up to 162 km/h. The storm is expected to continue affecting the region into Monday, with reports of over 1,600 flight cancellations and evacuations as residents prepare for the impact.
key_facts: Typhoon Dolphin made landfall on China's eastern coast.
Sustained winds reached up to 162 km/h.
The storm is expected to continue into Monday.
